Main changes
Known issues
You can now choose a card category in the gacha. Only cards from that category will be drawn.
You can now view update notes under "News" on the title screen.
The game now lets you know when a new version is available. You can keep playing without updating.
You can now scroll through card fusion descriptions and results to read them in full.
Title screen text is now larger and easier to read.
Added Profile, WHY I RUN, permanent challenges, badges, and preset messages.
Added castle town scenery to Wasteland Road from 10km onward.
Revised card categories (COMMON・WILDERNESS・CAVE・SKY・LAST DUNGEON).
Adjusted the difficulty of consecutive battles from 95km onward.
Fixed an issue that could grant enemy defeat and BREAK rewards twice when resuming an interrupted run.
